have_value_reask.feedback: [HAVE-VALUE] The customer has already retrieved and confirmed the last 4 digits of the card: {value}. You already have this value - do NOT ask for it again and do NOT re-run any lookup for it. File the dispute NOW: unlock file_credit_card_transaction_dispute and call it via call_discoverable_agent_tool with the transaction_id of the charge being disputed and card_last_4_digits='{value}'. Then move on to the next disputed charge.

Δspurious: 넛지는 요구된 write만 유도(새 write 안 만듦)·미실재면 미발화.

prescription_redirect.feedback: Error: [PRESCRIPTION] the customer is describing a disputed or unauthorized charge. That is handled by FILING A FORMAL DISPUTE (file_credit_card_transaction_dispute), NOT by applying a statement credit. apply_statement_credit is only for goodwill adjustments, promotional credits, or fee reversals - never for disputing a charge. First file the dispute: it is a DISCOVERABLE tool, so find its full suffixed name in the knowledge base (search plain words like "file credit card dispute"), unlock it, and call it with the transaction and card details. Do not apply a statement credit for a disputed charge.

KB=doc_014/017. requires_absent_tool=file_dispute 이미 호출 시 통과(dispute 후 정당 provisional credit 보호). ★[[05]] 회색: signals=dispute판정 근사(유동판단 동결 우려)·기본 OFF·Δspurious(정당 credit 오차단) rall12 계측. value_acquisition.feedback: [VALUE-ACQUIRE] The customer cannot read the last 4 digits off the card and they are NOT stored in the account records - they must be retrieved by the CUSTOMER running get_card_last_4_digits. Stop re-asking the customer for them. Use give_discoverable_user_tool to give get_card_last_4_digits to the customer NOW, then have them run it with their credit_card_account_id and read the value from its output. Then file the dispute with that value.
value_acquisition._note: 2026-07-23 C119(8-task per-step 포렌식·031hv/039 실측): have-value의 앞단계 = 값 획득 경로 실패. 에이전트가 last-4를 재요청하나 ①값 미실재(producer 성공출력0) ②계좌record에 없음 ③get_card_last_4_digits를 give_discoverable_user_tool로 손님에게 안 줌 → 손님이 값 못 얻어 재요청 무한→draft만 열고 STOP(031hv) 또는 앱로그인 안내(039). 031 base는 give함→file 도달(pass). 검출기=재요청∧값미실재∧give미실행(엔진 일반·[[05]]). have-value(값 실재)와 상보·상호배타(값 있으면 skip).
